transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'd like to get our launch signoff conversation started for the new usage-based billing meter. As you know, it's passed sandbox integration tests and we're targeting next month's billing cycle. The current draft has us doing an immediate broad launch, two-decimal half-up rounding, 90 days of raw usage-event retention, and no mandatory invoice-preview review. Before I approve, I need to check in with each of you — billing engineering, finance operations, privacy, and customer support — to make sure there are no blockers or concerns from your side. What are your thoughts?

transcript.text: I need to flag a concern before we proceed. While I was validating an older contract adapter during a separate billing reconciliation task, I confirmed that annual-credit contracts require six-decimal meter precision and half-even rounding to avoid cumulative invoice discrepancies. This finding has not yet been added to the launch checklist. The current draft specifies two-decimal half-up rounding, which would be insufficient for annual-credit contracts and could lead to cumulative invoice discrepancies over the year. I think we need to address this before moving forward.
